messages.subject: Issue Running Bootstrap
parts:

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Issue Running Bootstrap
parts:
> fitH5I<-sem(H5I, data=datmod, std.lv=T, group="RELTYPE", se="boot",
> bootstrap=1000)

Add verbose = TRUE, and you will have a better overview of what is going
wrong.

I noticed that you imposed a lot of (linear) equality constraints (for
effects coding). Could you try the development version (0.5-18) for this
analysis? (see http://lavaan.org/development.html for installation
instructions). We have a new method in place that avoids constrained
optimization, and this should give less convergence problems.

Let us know if this worked.

Yves.

messages.author: 0d5b7d74dea6b6ad
messages.subject: Re: Issue Running Bootstrap
parts:
Yves,
It worked.  It still took quite some time to run, however, using development version (0.5-18) ran smoothly, and verbose allowed me to follow along with each iteration. 

I ran the boot-strap a week or so ago and it ran, but when I went back because I needed additional figures, I couldn't get it to run, but now all is well!

Thank you so much for your assistance!

Sara
